title: Herdr local runs still run the pi CLI; pi-durable hosting there needs a design
description:
The durable local host landed on the harness substrate (the subprocess executor, which spawns headless workers per worktree). But substrate=auto on this host resolves to HERDR, whose agents are interactive CLIs defined in the operator's own herdr config — a herdr agent template is static, so per-attempt state (the worker.json path, the storage, the steer socket) cannot ride one, and pi-durable is a headless host anyway. Until a herdr-side design exists (a herdr agent kind that shells the Node entry with per-attempt arguments, or runs pinning substrate=harness), a local epic run on the herdr substrate runs its non-frontier workers on the pi CLI, not on the harness. The acceptance's real local run can pin substrate=harness today; the alternative is an operator decision about whether herdr hosts pi-durable at all, given its agents are operator-configured outside this repository.
evidence: internal/exec/herdr/executor.go (Options.Kind — a herdr agent kind); internal/runconfig/substrate.go (Decide: auto → herdr when the probe finds it); this tick's diff touches only internal/exec/subprocess
